propositions: When file_impact is undeclared, code-SHA drift currently invalidates on any change (307/1457 re-reviews on byte-identical material); scoping the fail-safe to read-set and cited blast-radius paths reduces false positives while preserving drift detection.

The signed manifest must record normalized read-paths (from usage_log distinct_fetches tool=read_file) after filtering non-existent files, resolving relative paths, and deduping; a modified read-set cannot survive verification.

Currency validity reuses ADR-0002 content-hash machinery over read-set ∪ blast-radius only when the pre-existing dependency set is empty, container poison rule is inactive, ticket scope is undeclared, and a read-set was recorded.

Glob patterns in the blast-radius (rebar.toml, criteria/**, reviewers/**, gates/**) are handled via membership digest (sha256 of sorted matches) to detect additions/deletions; plain paths hash via _hash_file.
Unverifiable read-set, pre-change attestations lacking the field, and expansion failures fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (fail-safe).

plan_review_status reports currency-basis (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) from the signed manifest; attestation minting for ticket 81ca-9443-3443-4d27 failed on lock contention after PASS verdict, blocking close pending re-run authorization.
